parsed.explanation: Rated as a state-level division under a restrictive national parent regime. Parent exposures apply to every visitor: passports restricted to birth sex with the X marker ended, documented passport confiscation and stranding, entry refusal with a possible lifetime fraud finding, documented abuse and forced labour in immigration custody, and federal official hostility framing trans advocacy as terrorism. The division adds documented protections that operate: shield laws enforceable against outside action, a court-ordered and insurance-mandated care regime, refuge protections, and no documented state bathroom ban. Its documented negatives are birth-sex housing used as a disciplinary sanction (July 2024, post-period unknown) and two pending ballot initiatives whose outcome is unsourced. Net, it sits above the parent average but remains in the reduced-to-elevated band because the national entry and document exposure reaches every traveller regardless of state protections.
